description: A link the person can open to get one file — the campaign PDF, a product still, a video. Works for any file in the workspace, including ones too big or too binary to read as text. The link expires within the hour.

path.description: File path relative to the workspace, as shown by list_workspace_files.

session_id.description: Link a file from a campaign shared with this account rather than its own files. Omit for your own workspace.
